title: List the names of countries where matches were played during the 2015/2016
question: List the names of countries where matches were played during the 2015/2016 season that involved at least one home team with a player who: (a) weighs less than 140, (b) is left-footed, and (c) has an overall rating above 80 in any attribute record from 2010 to 2016. Only include countries where such matches occurred.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_002
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON c.XCL_001 = m.XCL_007
JOIN Player p ON m.XCL_013 = p.XCL_122
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  AND p.XCL_127 < 140
  AND pa.XCL_134 = 'left'
  AND pa.XCL_132 > 80
  AND pa.XCL_131 >= '2010-01-01'
  AND pa.XCL_131 <= '2016-12-31'
